cases.name: Cynthia M. “Cyndie” Karmon Lively
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Cyndie was a fun-loving, genuine soul who lived by the words “dance like no one is watching.” She had an ability to lighten the mood in any situation. Her pride and joy was her four fur babies, and loved to bring her pups with her on long hauls throughout her career as a truck driver.

Cyndie enjoyed several years as a seasonal camper where she formed many lasting friendships. She could find the joy in either a night at home coloring or a night sitting at the slot machines hoping for a big win. Her unwavering dependability and love for her family is how she will always be remembered."
